boundary: This retained trace verifies throughput per claim in batched CUDA inference; it is not a single-request latency measurement. The GPU model is not recorded.
change_note: Sérgio Pinto, 2026-08-21 21:31 PDT — Parsed the retained CUDA benchmark trace and its exact evaluation source to verify the batch-amortized four-head latency boundary.
paper_claim: less than 10 ms per claim on a single GPU
scope: batch-amortized benchmark loop with batch size 32; includes tokenization, host-to-device copies, model forward pass, softmax, GPU-to-CPU transfer, NumPy conversion, and progress-loop overhead; excludes model loading and dataset file reading
